messages:
claire: Drafting RN for Fri midnight deploy (window 2026-03-27 23:55-00:55 PT). Need quick ops checklist: canary lanes, model pin, fallback, rollback owners.
ben: Canary lanes: prod-canary-main, mobile-canary. Plan to pin model:v2.0.0-quant.
omar: Fallback -> model:v1.9.0-quant2. Rollback triggers: sustained p95 >1.8s for 5m OR error rate >1% for 10m OR regression >5% on our smoke prompts.
tess: I'll draft the internal announce copy and schedule. Need final RN by Thu 18:00 PT.
claire: Ops, please run a quick deploy simulate and post preview. Command?
ben: /deploy simulate release/2026-03-27 --canary prod-canary-main --pin model:v2.0.0-quant
deploy-bot: Received simulate command from ben. Validating manifests... OK. Canary pools available.
deploy-bot: Preview: https://deploy.internal/preview/1778890000
omar: Add rollout policy: pin_model=true and max_canary_traffic=3% for fast rollback.
claire: Add obs dash link + cost note (approx +10% token cost). Link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/release-1778890000
sre-oncall: Change window approved. Oncall will monitor and has thresholds set according to runbook.
tess: I'll post eng+product 1h before and company internal-only 15m before if green. Who will own immediate rollback steps?
omar: I will. Short playbook: 1) SRE disable canary traffic. 2) Ops revert model pin to v1.9.0-quant2. 3) Run smoke tests and confirm. Approvers: omar + ben.
claire: Final reviewers: ben (ops), tess (comms), omar (sre). Sign-off needed by Thu 18:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Simulation traffic: p95=0.85s, error rate=0.25%. No issues.
claire: Great, thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Thu 18:30 for final go/no-go. :rocket:
